# Ploopy A+ factory source

These files are verbatim from `ploopyco/qmk_firmware` at `ed6bc4231cc0c39f5f4c0ff82f0d5ad5d8ef7e6e`, branch `ploopyco/a+`:

- `keyboards/ploopyco/aplus/keymaps/default/keymap.c`
- `keyboards/ploopyco/aplus/keymaps/default/config.h`
- `keyboards/ploopyco/aplus/keymaps/default/rules.mk`
- `keyboards/ploopyco/aplus/keymaps/default/keymap.json`
- `keyboards/ploopyco/aplus/info.json`

The upstream firmware uses GPL-2.0-or-later. [LICENSE](LICENSE) contains the GPL version 2 text. These fixtures contain the factory layout, with no private configuration or device serial.
